title: Pollution Characteristics and Ecological Risks of Perfluoroalkyl Substances at Key Discharge Points in the Wei River Basin
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00771B, Paper
Siyao Zhang, Lulei Zhang, Qinming Zhang, Chun Zhang, Guoqing Zhou, Lumei Gao, Nan Deng, Weidong Wu, Lingjie Meng
Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are increasingly recognized as persistent global contaminants with significant health implications. This study offers the first thorough assessment of 19 PFAS across 21 discharge points...
